blocks.text: Step 1: Open Gemini in Sheets
Open a new or existing Google Sheet, then click Ask Gemini to open the Gemini side panel.
Step 2: Prompt Gemini to create a table
Describe the tracker or table you need, including the purpose, columns, and any starting data.

blocks.alt: Prompt Gemini to create a table

blocks.text: Step 3: Review the created table
Check the generated headers, rows, and structure. Adjust column names, statuses, or missing fields before using it.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Create a [project/event/team] tracker in Google Sheets with columns for Owner, Task, Priority, Due Date, Status, and Notes. Add 10 realistic starter rows.
blocks.title: Ready-to-use prompt

blocks.text: Step 1: Select the column to complete
Choose the column where Gemini should infer or generate missing values, such as category, description, or status.
Step 2: Fill extra rows
Use Gemini to continue the pattern from existing rows or generate content for blank cells.
Step 3: Run the generative cell action
Apply Gemini's suggestion to the selected range, then scan for consistency and edge cases.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Fill the blank cells in column [column name] using the pattern from the completed rows. Keep the output concise and consistent with the existing categories.

blocks.text: Step 1: Ask Gemini for a formula
Explain the calculation you need in plain English and identify the relevant columns or cells.
Step 2: Apply the formula to real data
Paste or accept the formula, then test it against the row values in your sheet.

blocks.alt: Apply the formula to real data

blocks.text: Step 3: Ask questions about the result
Use Gemini to explain the result, spot mistakes, or answer a question from the table.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Write a Google Sheets formula for [business rule]. My data has [column A meaning], [column B meaning], and [column C meaning]. Explain where to paste it and how to fill it down.
blocks.title: Ready-to-use prompt

blocks.text: Step 1: Ask Gemini to analyze your sheet
Open a dataset and ask Gemini for patterns, anomalies, or summary insights.

blocks.alt: Ask Gemini to analyze the sheet

blocks.text: Step 2: Create a chart
Ask Gemini to turn the data into a relevant chart, such as a pie chart, bar chart, or trend chart.
Step 3: Use insights in a dashboard
Review the chart and Gemini's explanation, then decide what action the data supports.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Analyze this sheet and tell me the top 3 insights, the biggest risk, and the best chart to show the trend to a manager.

blocks.text: Step 1: Open Gemini for a Sheets task
Start with a specific Sheets problem you want solved without manually writing code.

blocks.alt: Open Gemini for a Sheets task

blocks.text: Step 2: Ask for data insights or automation help
Describe the exact output you want, such as a summary, script, calculation, or workflow.

blocks.alt: Ask for data insights or automation help

blocks.text: Step 3: Use the answer without code expertise
Review Gemini's response and apply it inside Sheets or Apps Script depending on the task.

blocks.alt: Use the answer without code expertise

Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.

blocks.text: Step 1: Start from source data
Take a screenshot or photo of a table, receipt, chart, or structured list.
Step 2: Prompt Gemini to structure it
Ask Gemini to read the image and convert the visible information into a clean table.
Step 3: Review the structured sheet
Check headings, row count, dates, numbers, and any ambiguous text before using the output.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Turn the data in this image into a spreadsheet table. Preserve the original columns, normalize dates and numbers, and mark anything uncertain as "Needs review".
blocks.title: Ready-to-use prompt

blocks.text: Step 1: Open the Apps Script platform
Open a Sheet, then go to Extensions > Apps Script to prepare the automation workspace.
Step 2: Select the Sheets add-on or script target
Confirm the automation is connected to the correct Google Sheet and workflow.

blocks.alt: Select the Sheets add-on or script target

blocks.text: Step 3: Edit the code block
Paste Gemini's Apps Script, save the project, refresh the Sheet, and run the menu or function.

blocks.alt: Edit the code block for automation

blocks.text: Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Create a Google Apps Script for my Sheet that adds a custom menu called "AI Boost Action" and, when clicked, shows a success alert. Include the full code and setup steps.

blocks.text: Step 1: Ask Gemini to analyze data
Open a dataset and ask Gemini a clear analysis question about spending, performance, or trends.
Step 2: Create a visualization
Ask Gemini to create the best chart for the question, then insert it into the sheet.
Step 3: Review strategic insights
Use Gemini's explanation to identify what action to take next.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Create a chart that shows [metric] by [category], then explain the biggest insight, the likely cause, and one action I should take next.
blocks.title: Ready-to-use prompt

blocks.text: Step 1: Prepare sortable data
Use a sheet with category, date, and numeric columns so Gemini has enough structure to work with.
Step 2: Ask a natural language question
Use plain English to ask Gemini to sort, filter, format, or explain the data.
Step 3: Filter, sort, or visualize
Apply Gemini's action and confirm the output matches your intended view.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Sort this sheet by [number column] from highest to lowest, highlight values over [threshold] in green, and filter to only show [category].

lessons.title: Talk to Your Data in Sheets

blocks.text: Step 1: Type the AI function
Use =AI() in a cell to generate text from a prompt and another cell's value.
Step 2: Generate text at scale
Fill the formula down so Sheets generates copy, summaries, or labels across many rows.
Step 3: Summarize or categorize data
Use =AI() to summarize long text, classify sentiment, assign categories, or standardize messy entries.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this formula and adapt it to your sheet.
=AI("Summarize this customer feedback in 10 words or less and classify sentiment as Positive, Negative, or Mixed.", A2)
blocks.title: Formula idea

lessons.title: AI Magic in a Sheets Cell

blocks.text: Step 1: Reference source notes
Choose a Google Drive file with meeting notes, project details, tasks, or budget information.
Step 2: Prompt for an organized tracker
In Gemini, reference the source file with @ and ask it to create a tracker or table.
Step 3: Review the generated tracker
Check the generated columns, colors, categories, and action items before using the tracker.
Step 4: Takeaway
Copy this prompt and paste it into Ask Gemini.
Create a project tracker using the tasks in @ [file name]. Include Owner, Task, Priority, Due Date, Status, Budget Impact, and Next Step.
blocks.title: Ready-to-use prompt
